backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only same-day vendor flow plus signal-date OHLCV context. Paper entry is next-session open with entry fill slippage; exit is the 10th-trading-day close with sell slippage; trades whose exit falls outside the frozen window are not scored.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window accepted core baseline plus default-off paper overlay from the shared moomoo capital-flow sleeve replay

execution_envelope.notes: Top-1/day, $4,000 fixed default-off paper notional, 10-trading-day close exit, same-day core-overlap exclusion in the daily path. The daily source additionally depends on a live local OpenD; a dead OpenD degrades to zero candidates without touching the ledger.

full_stack.materiality_note: Strict materiality recorded for transparency; the binding standard for candidate sources is beating the accepted comparators after costs.
